Fact.Name: Is Resubmitting
Fact.Description: Whether the Tax Payer has already submitted their return once, and is now resubmitting.
Is "today" after the filer's tax deadline This fact needs to be re-evaluated.

Is "today" after the filer's tax deadline and is this not a resubmission (for which the filer would have more time). Derived as All(/isAfterTaxDay, not-resubmitting). COMPLETENESS DECISION: an unanswered /isResubmitting reads as a FIRST submission (False), so this fact stays Complete on a return that never answered the resubmission question - complete-safe. Through the filing deadline (2026-04-15) it resolves False either way; node fixtures deadline-trio-* pin both sides of the boundary with explicit /todayOverride dates. DISCLOSURE/ROUTING ONLY: no dictionary fact reads this; it exists for the application screen routing. It must not join /flowIsKnockedOut: no federal authority makes lateness a bar to computing.

Is "today" after the resubmission deadline, meaning DF is fully closed. Derived as signing:/today strictly after constants:/resubmissionDeadline. April 20, 2026 itself is the last accepted day; only the day after opens this window. NO STATUTE, DELIBERATELY: the resubmission window is a Direct File operating date set by the service (constants:/resubmissionDeadline, administrative, five days after the filing deadline per the L0 pattern), not a date any Code section fixes, so this fact stays on the statute-anchor allowlist, whose row records that it computes the service window. DISCLOSURE/ROUTING ONLY: no dictionary fact reads this; it exists for the application screen routing. It must not join /flowIsKnockedOut: no federal authority makes lateness a bar to computing.

Is "today" before or up to the federal tax deadline. Derived as the exact complement of the module's anchored comparison /isAfterTaxDay, so "before or up to" means signing:/today less than or equal to filers:/taxDay. DISCLOSURE/ROUTING ONLY: no dictionary fact reads this; it exists for the application screen routing. It must not join /flowIsKnockedOut: no federal authority makes lateness a bar to computing.
